productShellLabels.ritualAfterCoding: Update the DCC whenever readiness, workflow direction, or shell truth changes.

driftGuardrails: Define the operator shell once and import it everywhere.
Keep All / Buyers / Suppliers visible as a workspace-wide perspective, not a page-specific trick.
Do not bury the pipeline view behind language that hides the actual pipeline.
Treat dashboard as a leadership support surface with geo, market, and country visibility, not as a leftover report page.
Settings and admin must become comprehensible governed surfaces, not internal-tool junk drawers.
Keep the DCC as the single source of truth for readiness, PR-UX status, and workflow direction.
Catalog base price remains the system default; manual overrides require an auditable reason.
Approval remains mandatory when the configured threshold is met, and send surfaces must not outrun that truth.
Orders and execution must prove release and dispatch readiness from accepted commercial truth rather than branching into parallel realities.
The DCC must label workflow confidence honestly: core flow, support surface, or unclear / mixed.
